Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the

- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

keyFacts: Las ofertas deberán contener la documentación técnica solicitada en 10.1. “documentación técnica” para demostrar los aspectos de experiencia de la persona física, empresa y capacidad técnica para cumplir con las especificaciones técnicas descritas en el presente pliego de condiciones, la cual será evaluada bajo la metodología: Cumple/No Cumple.

En la metodología de evaluación CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE, todos los documentos referidos en el numeral 10.1. “documentación técnica” serán divididos entre aquellos que se evalúan bajo el esquema Cumple/No Cumple”
11.5. Metodología y criterios de evaluación de oferta económica

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

Status rules:
- met: sufficient evidence supports compliance; name the DOC codes.
- not_met: sufficient evidence proves non-compliance; explain why.
- unknown: the information does not allow a decision. A missing
  document is NOT proof of non-compliance — use unknown, except when
  the tender makes the document a CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE admissibility
  criterion and it is structurally absent: that is not_met.
- not_applicable: the requirement does not apply; justify why.

Judgment rules:
- A distributor quotation supports price and availability but NEVER
  proves manufacturer authorization or partnership; say so explicitly.
- An expired document (see warnings) cannot prove current compliance.
- When two sources disagree, say so in the reason; never pick silently.
- blocker is true ONLY when the gap cannot be closed before the tender
  closes. A gap fixable in time is never a blocker. Decide by what the
  tender accepts:
  * If it accepts a letter from the manufacturer OR an authorized
    distributor/supplier, and the company works with a supplier of that
    product line (see suppliers in the facts), the letter is obtainable
    before closing: not_met with blocker false, suggestedOwner the
    supplier relationship owner, and the action "request the letter".
  * It is a blocker when the tender requires the BIDDER itself to hold a
    status it lacks and cannot acquire in time (manufacturer partner or
    channel program such as Microsoft CSP, years of experience, number
    of past contracts), or the criterion is CUMPLE/NO CUMPLE and no
    route to the document exists.
- blockerBasis (only when blocker is true): "clear" when the company
  plainly lacks what the tender demands of the bidder; "disputed" when
  it might be met another way (partner, subcontractor, consortium) or
  the wording is ambiguous for this bidder. Use null when not a blocker.
- Technical specifications of GOODS to be supplied (models, speeds,
  ports, standards, warranty of the equipment) describe the product the
  bidder will offer, not the company. They are met by quoting a
  compliant model through a supplier: status unknown with the action
  "obtain a quotation for a compliant model", never a blocker. Only the
  bidder's own experience, staff and certifications are judged against
  the company evidence.
- Contract-execution clauses (penalties, rescission causes, obligations
  after award) are not_applicable at bid stage unless they demand a
  document with the offer.
- Forms, declarations, and commitments the bidder completes during bid
  preparation (SNCC.F.xxx forms, sworn statements, bonds to be issued)
  are satisfiable actions: mark unknown with a recommendedAction to
  complete them, never not_met. Reserve not_met for qualifications the
  company cannot currently prove (experience, certifications,
  authorizations, references).
- requiresHumanReview is true when the evidence is thin, conflicting,
  expired, or the stakes are high despite the status.
- Cover every listed requirement exactly once, by its id.

data.summary: Tender ISFODOSU-CCC-LPN-2026-0003 solicita Adquisicion, instalacion y configuracion de equipos de red y seguridad Wi-Fi por DOP 8743800 con cierre 2026-11-10 09:00. NovaTech Solutions, SRL [DOC-LEGAL-001, DOC-LEGAL-002, DOC-CORP-001] tiene capacidad parcial relevante en Infraestructura y redes con alcance Wi-Fi verificado en PROJECT-004 [DOC-CONTRACT-004, DOC-ACCEPTANCE-004] y Suministro tecnologico via distribuidores [DOC-QUOT-001..004], pero presenta brechas de escala, certificacion vencida y falta de autorizaciones de fabricante. Recomendacion preliminar: needs_review pendiente de pliego y verificaciones.
data.justification: Existe afinidad parcial de objeto (Wi-Fi/redes verificado en PROJECT-004 [DOC-CONTRACT-004, DOC-ACCEPTANCE-004] e ingeniero asignado [DOC-CV-005]) pero con brechas materiales de escala (8.9x), CCNA vencida [DOC-CERT-EXP-001], falta de autorizaciones de fabricante y cotizaciones no utilizables. No es NO-GO automatico porque no es licitacion de licencias, pero requiere revision completa de pliego, recotizacion y analisis financiero/legal antes de decidir BID. Recomendacion preliminar solo con datos generales; elegibilidad final se decide tras analisis documental y de cumplimiento.

Ingeniero de Infraestructura en equipo: Carlos Daniel Reyes Santana — Personal tecnico disponible para instalacion y configuracion — DOC-CV-005, DOC-TEAM-001

incompatibilities: scale — Desproporcion de escala: monto referencia DOP 8743800 es ~8.9x mayor que unico proyecto Wi-Fi previo de DOP 980000 y ~85% de ingresos anuales 2025 de DOP 10200000 — DOC-CONTRACT-004, DOC-FIN-2024, DOC-FIN-2025

object — Sin autorizaciones de fabricante; brecha critica si pliego exige carta de distribuidor autorizado para equipos de red/seguridad Wi-Fi. Sin autorizacion Microsoft partner / fabricantes y sin ISO empresariales — profile - Known gap Sin autorizacion, DOC-CORP-001
